watermark.reason: Query-form ?sort= is NOOP via plain HTTP (lowestprice == highestprice == newest == default, identical first-8 product IDs on /firearms/ and /22-lr/). But default DOM order is monotonic-descending BigCommerce auto-increment product-id (page1 /firearms/ ends ~10161, page2 starts 10149,10148...; /22-lr/ default 10098,10097,10043...), which IS newest-first. navigate-from-watermark paginates page 1 (newest) and walks back to the watermark using natural ID-desc order.

topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck: INCONCLUSIVE in R1: category tree is NON-RECURSIVE on this BC instance. /ammunition/ page-1 IDs do NOT overlap /22-lr/ page-1 IDs (1/12 common) -> top-level parents do NOT contain their per-caliber children. 251 category locs in sitemap, mostly per-caliber leaf cats (/22-lr/, /308/, /9mm/, etc.). The 16 top-level firearm-relevant catalogUrls above are a CANDIDATE spine whose union has NOT been ID-deduped against the 3509-product sitemap. Full coverage proof (walk every leaf category, union product-ids, compare to 3509) is DEFERRED to R2 — exceeds R1 blind budget.

stageNotes: Stage 1: canonical = apex https://oleysarmoury.com (www 301->apex; <link rel=canonical> = apex). robots.txt has NO Sitemap: directive; sitemap index found at /xmlsitemap.php.
Stage 2: hasWaf=false (cloudflare-passive). cf-ray everywhere but catalog 200 across all UAs/burst/no-UA/SQLi. Honeypot+XSS filtered on attack paths only. No CAPTCHA, no age-gate.
Stage 3: platform=bigcommerce-stencil (cdn11.bigcommerce.com x59, stencil- class). adapterType=generic-retail. needsPlaywright=false (plain HTTP returns full product cards).
Stage 4: catalogUrls is a CANDIDATE top-level spine. Tree is non-recursive -> coverage UNPROVEN. expectedProductCount=3509 from product sitemap is the ground truth to dedup against in R2.
Stage 5: paginationPattern query ?page=N, firstPageHasParam=false, perPage=100 (server cap; limit=250 returned 100). page1 vs page2 = 0 overlap.
Stage 6: ?sort= is NOOP via plain HTTP (4-way identical: default/newest/lowestprice/highestprice). sortParam=null, sortVerified=false.
Stage 7: watermark=navigate-from-watermark. Default DOM order = BC auto-increment product-id DESC (independent newest-first signal, cross-referenced across /firearms/ and /22-lr/).
Stage 8: expectedProductCount=3509. productCountMethod=generic-product-sitemap on /xmlsitemap.php?type=products&page=1 with product-URL pattern filter.
Stage 9: validator not run in R1 scratch (read-only); shape assembled per Output target. Stage 10 runtime-sim DEFERRED to R2.
